properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
1.5 miles out of harbor.
Mom, calf, escort pod. Escort was only present for 2 of 4 surfacings.  All whales were pretty lazy with no surface behaviors besides breathing and occasionally fluke-up diving or rounding out in the case of the calf. The mom and calf were up every 3-4 minutes. Trilogy V was also with the whales for the first 5 minutes of the encounter.
Encounter lasted 15 minutes.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: slowly cruising whale towards lahaina

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mid-channel between Lahaina and Lana'i. Sub adult breaching several times!!! Interaction lasted about 10 minutes

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We first observed this humpback whale about 5 miles offshore the Pali tunnel. Large splashes appeared from where we initially observed, indicating active surface behavior. Once we arrived close to this individual, the surface activity diminished. While waiting for this whale to surface, a school of spotted dolphins appeared nearby (logged separately).

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: young whale nearby and heading towards group of spotted dolphins.  few breaths and dive.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Spotted blows from pretty far off the starboard bow from two whales. Breathed a couple of times before deep diving. One fluke up dive and one fluke dive.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
location:  3 miles off oluwalu

2 humpbacks, few breaths and fluke up dive from 1/2 mile...didn't see them after dive

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: two 30 ft, hbw large subadults, maybe nearing adult grouping

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, yearling and escort. Some trumpeting, a couple of small head lunges.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Yearling with white pecs swimming with a pod of bnd. We were paralleling the whale at about 150 yards and it turned directly towards us. When it approached within 100 yards we went into neutral and it eventually swam directly up to the boat, cruising along the sides just underwater, within a yard of the boat. Swam entirely around the boat before cruising off and headed back towards the dolphins which had swam off.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Smaller size but dark black and white tail; adult or subadult.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: two whales moving around erratically. at least another whale maybe more hanging out on the outskirts. big direction changes underwater. head rises from one whale. Very interesting...

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Incredible behavior for this early in the season!   Comp pod!  Bottlenose dolphin showed up with group.  Speculate that female mostly under boat, swimming belly up (turquoise on ventral side and tail) swimming underneath us back and forth.  A lot of aggressive head lunges, bubble blasts/walls and inflated head lunges!  Two challenges for primary escort position observed.  2 males left group.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Competition pod, and Bottlenose dolphins all around the competition pod. Whales were spotted pectoral fin slapping, peduncle slapping and breaching!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Competition pod, and Bottlenose dolphins all around the competition pod. Whales were spotted pectoral fin slapping, peduncle slapping and breaching!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We found the same group on our second whale watch. We recognize the same whales, we believe that the female has an all white belly and flukes she is constantly rolling over and revealing her pectoral fins. The bottlenose are still with these whales! Competition behavior is still being observed. This has been unbelievable.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 3 blows, fluke up dive

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: whales with a few dolphins (unsure of species of dolphin)

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: whales with a few dolphins (unsure of species of dolphin)

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Smaller Whale surface active, tail slapping and BREACHING!! We can't believe the day today, the wind is howling to the north and south of us and right in this small area is a break in the wind and the whales are all in this small area. We are so lucky!! Unbelievable day!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: A small sub-adult located 2 miles off shore just east of Lahaina town. Three bottlenose dolphins interacting with these whales. During our observation the individual whale observation became a larger group, consisting of four whales. Aggressive behavior, including bubble blowing was seen.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Constant swimming, one animal fluke up diving.  left tip of the fluke is missing!  Very cool.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Two males, 1 female. One male spotted bubble blasting and head lunging, another male entered the pod near the end of the sighting.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
location: 3 miles off molokini
few breaths and fluke up dive, beautiful fluke, large white patches surrounded by thick black border and center.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
location: 4 miles offshore olowalu
subadult, few breaths and dive, changed direction from north to southwest to go under bow of boat and continued on its way

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 1 adult humpback who briefly came to the surface, took two breaths, and did a round out dive.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
location:2.5 miles off olowalu

few breaths and dive, continue pattern

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: One surfacing so far.  no fluke up dive. had to come all the way past lahaina harbor to find a whale.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: No surface activities, dives after a few blows.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp group. Lots of head lunges.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: A group of seven humpback whales located .75 miles out of the harbor. We viewed this competitive behavior while we were leaving the harbor but once we arrived to observe these whales it appeared that this whales began to compete by holding their breath. Very exciting to see such a large group early in the season.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Smaller juvenile diving after a few blows. No surface behaviors.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: nice encounter with lazy comp pod, a peduncle throw, some trumpeting, a few head rises. longer bottom times, but still plenty of surface activity. we stayed with the pod about an hour. we were 4 miles off lahaina, in perfect conditions. beautiful sunrise

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
location: between lanai and lahaina, 3 miles off lanai and 5 miles off lahaina

comp pod, few tail flicks, watched for a whlie about 200 yards from boat a lot of the time, as went to leave came up right near boat 80 yards.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 whales, one a large calf/sub adult.  This whale breached 3 times in a row after doing a bit of rolling around extending its pec fin out of the water. The other whale only blew a few times then disappeared.  Unsure of the size.  Sighting was right outside the harbor and lasted 10 minutes before we continued on to molokini.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Fluke up dive off 3:00 coming our way.  Next surfacing moving away from us southbound 350 yards away.  One whale with white patches at corners of fluke, 2nd fluke up dive smaller with all black, 3rd white elongated patches on fluke.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: sub adult with whale lice. sad, sickly, whale. lots of pink whale lice visible every time the animal dove. along the tail stock and underside of body. also a couple of notches on top of tail stock, as if the whale had been entangled at some point. we stayed with the whale for an hour as it swam slowly north and did shallow dives. definitely did not look like a healthy whale

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: nice, but windy encounter with same pod as sighted on first whale watch. slow comp pod with longer down times and very little surface activity. just a few surfacings in the hour we spent with them. same spot as before, 4 miles off lahaina

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: juvenile, most likely a yearling or just older, fluke print still gray (most of fluke white), underside of pecs solid white. watched whale for 40 min whole time was rolling, tail slapping, peduncle throw, and surfaced every 3-4 min.. . whale was mid channel between lahaina and lanai, about 4 mi off lahaina

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mugging!  Comp pod.  Lots of direction changes, next to boat!!  On all sides.  Lots of heavy exasperated blows and fluke up/fluke down dives.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Bottlenose dolphins and humpback whales swimming west together. More dolphins than seen on first whale watch.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 25 min down time with 3 blows in between

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Quick sighting on the way out to Molokini

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Quick sighting on the way out to Molokini

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Young juvenile humpback whale with whale lice on dorsal side.  Right pectoral fin, ventral surface white coloration with pink and red small scratches/wounds.  Lots of pec slaps to see this.  Fluke up dives show the scarring around the peduncle muscle and healed wound of a previous entanglement of line around fluke.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: young subadult, pec slapping. when approached discovery, they told us it was the same whale from day before that had entanglment scars on tail and was covered in whale lice on ventral surface near peduncle.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: young subadult past windline towards channel between lanai and molokai. peduncle throws and cruising with dorsal right at surface.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 whales, fluke up dives.  side by side.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: same sub adult spotted earlier moving towards olawalu along the Pali. multiple breaching but long resting times between activities. some peduncle throws, tail slaps.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: two adult (?) HBWs, swimming slowly, about 2 mi off Launiupoko; btlnose dolphins swimming alongside

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Same pair as observed on previous trip.  No BND with them.  Diving after a few surfacing, one fluke up dive, one fluke down dive, over and over again.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
Two whales exhibiting competitive behavior Head lunge, peduncle throws, head rise.
at least two bottlenose dolphins sighted in the immediate vicinity.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: incredible breach and a huge head slap. one pec slap and then a deep dive. woah! surprise encounter but surface off our starboard stern so not a 'near miss'

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod. Pec slapping, head lunging. Not traveling in any clear direction.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: watched with od, watched for 45 min, very surface active comp pod mid channel between lahaina and club lanai, down time 4-5 min, lots of direction changes, came within 40 yds of boat twice.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: At least three animals who were peduncle throwing repeatedly, and we even saw LOTS of tail slaps! This competition pod was very surface active and gave the passengers on OV a wonderful show before we made it to Molokini.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: at least 5 HBWs in competition group; many diving on top of one another; surfacing mainly to breathe--little aggression visible at the surface; other blows seen in vicinity of whales--over 400 yards away, unclear if other whales were previously part of competition group; about 2.5 mi off Ka'anapali; several whales approached port side of vessel within 100 yards

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Turning circles on its back and showing us its pectoral fins and belly. Seems as though its flukes are still a milky gray color, most likely a yearling or subadult.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mid channel between mala and lanai, about 5 mi off mala. watched for 1 hr., od was watching, for 45 min just saw one juvenile peduncle throws, tail slaps, rolling over. then an adult surfaced within 10 ft, swam head on at the original whale made a circle, surfaced once more with it, then only saw original whale surface about 40 yds off stern tail up, then spy hopped, peduncle throw, roll, tail upward and was able to see hemispherical lobe.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Two adult whales sounded about 250 yards off our boat. While we waited for them to resurface we lowered the hydrophone to listen. We were dead in the water and the whales surfaced 50 yards in front of our boat!! They took three breaths and then sounded.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: This mother and calf has been spotted throughout the day by different vessels and is recognizable from two large wounds on the left side of the calf, forward of the dorsal.  The calf has a fully erect dorsal fin and was fairly robust looking.  The injuries, which appeared to be fairly recent, didn't seem to be slowing him/her down. We spent about 20 minutes observing the two.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: first little calf sightinhg of he season

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: competition pod encountered in windy part of channel between Maui, Lana'i, and Moloka'i; bubble blasting; 4-5 HBWs; one other vessels watching pod

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We were heading in towards Maalaea Harbor and a subadult HBW breached completely out of the water off of our starboard side (about 1:00 position.) It was a completely surprise encounter; the water is glassy and calm with no wind, and no one spotted a blow. The breach seemed to come out of nowhere. The animal then swam behind the boat and did a beautiful fluke up dive before swimming away. One of the greatest breaching whales I've witnessed.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: one sub adult had a distinct notch missing from dorsal fin. spotted leading competition pod last weekend, potential younger female with escort

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Just outside the Lahaina harbor, 1/4 mile past the cruise ship.  Flat calm ocean.  Dove and stayed down for about 15+ minutes. This is actually the same whales observed this morning on our 6:30am trip. One of the whales the one that dives first has half of its tails missing, the scaring looks fairly fresh with pink patches. There down time all day has been 22-25 minutes.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: downtime 20 min, watched for 45 min.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We sighted exhalation blows from two different whales on our way from Molokini to Lana'i.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: slow swimming side by side by side with quick fluke up dives

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Same whales we first saw on our 630am trip; one whale is missing half of the left side of its fluke.  This fluke is pink-ish and white along this fluke wound.  One whale has a flattened "nob-less/point-less" dorsal fin with a white scar along its top edge.  These whales had a 30 minute down time this morning.  These whales are further offshore than this morning, about 4 miles into the Auau channel towards Lanai.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Sub adult whale seen exhaling twice before a peduncle throw and one tail slap before it dove below the surface again.We stayed in the area for about ten minutes before deciding to move on for some other active whales that we heard about on the radio.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: we saw this animals do a response breach to another very far off. two more breaches on our way out to him but then just back to normal swimming and breathing.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: od watching first, just surfacing and diving, down time 25 min, then at third surfacing, they both breached and then a head slap, changed direction, then had shorter down times, 7 min, then went back to long down times.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: I recognize one of the whales from yesterday. We watched a competition pod all day yesterday and the whale we believed to be the female has a knobby scared dorsal fin and a white patchy tail. As they dove we lowered the hydrophone and listened to some very loud vocalization. They came up right as we were going to listen and mugged us and then once they dove we lowered the hydrophone.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: did not see any activity in area, then saw some  head lunging between three whales, they got very active, started traveling 8 kts, then over the next 25 min 3 more whales joined comp pod. all whales active and head lunging, and surfacing every 1 min. watched this consistent activity for 45 min before having to head back to harbor. also with original three whales was 5 bnd appearing to bow ride with lead whale, they stayed with humpbacks the entire time we watched

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mid channel between mala and club lanai. about 3 mi off lanai.  watched for 30 min. was surface active, peduncle throw, two breaches, then just dove and surfaced with 5 min down times

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: pec slapping as we approached. stopped pec slapping and rested at the surface before fluke up diving. had short down times and we stayed with the animal for 30 minutes. we are 3 miles from Launiupoko.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Saw a fluke up dive from about a mile away or so.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Two whales surfaced on our starboard side, came to the surface for two breaths and then dove. We saw a beautiful fluke of one whale and the other did a round out dive and then was out of view. We think they are having about ten minute down times or so.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Right outside Molokini.  Most likely an adult but we did not get very close.  We observed two blows followed by a fluke up dive, and the whale was gone.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: long bottom times (18-24 minutes) 1 mile offshore of Wailea

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 miles off NE lana'i.  bottlenose seen then blow in the group. other whales came to join and became comp pod.  Head lunges and lazy breach.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: whale surfaced behind us after a long down time in between our siting and an earlier siting by quicksilver. long down times so we decided to look for another whale after one surfacing.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Two separate pods of two whales each were spotted in this general area.  One group had been spotted on an earlier whale watch traveling towards the northeast. The second group of whales was observed approaching from the opposite direction.  Down times decreased from about 10 minutes to 3 minutes.  No active behaviors were observed.  We dropped the hydrophone after a surfacing and song was heard very clearly, unlikely from our whales, but many off in the distance.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: whale noticed because of repeating tail slapping. we noticed a calf in close proximity as well, but mother did not appear to be the tail slapper. head lunging was observed as well.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: whale noticed because of repeating tail slapping. we noticed a calf in close proximity as well, but mother did not appear to be the tail slapper. head lunging was observed as well.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
Random animal of unknown age surfacing every 5 or 6 minutes but not making a distinct blow or doing a fluke-up dive.  Watched it for 3 surfacings before we had to go.
2 miles off ukumehame.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 9/10 mile off the pali

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: nice, peaceful sunrise encounter with two adult humpbacks. we dropped the hydrophone as the animals had longish down times (15 minutes) and heard clear whale song. had 4 surfacings during our hour long encounter. beautiful sunrise. we are 2 miles from shore, just off Mala wharf area

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: lazy comp pod forming mid channel between lahaina and lanai. 3 miles off shore of lanai. some tail slapping and peduncle throws. long down times of 10-12 minutes. enjoyable encounter that lasted 45 minutes

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: lazy comp pod forming mid channel between lahaina and lanai. 3 miles off shore of lanai. some tail slapping and peduncle throws. long down times of 10-12 minutes. enjoyable encounter that lasted 45 minutes

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Yearling displaying repeated breaching. Up to 15 to 20 times.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: At least 4 whales, possible 5.  Comp pod: inflated head lunges, multiple fluke up dives with down times of 3-4 minutes, bubble blasts.  About 3 miles off Lahaina town towards Lanai; sharing with vessels Kaulana and Cane Fire.  Whales traveling in no particular direction but circling around each other and surfacing at random.  This pod is in the same location--according to Captain's GPS--as when we saw them at 12:45pm today.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 4 animal comp pod! lots of action! visible bloody tubercles and dorsal on one of the males. directional changes, short down times, mugging! male with bloody tubercles surfaced at 15 feet off the stern. 45 minute encounter at 4 miles off olowalu

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: The crew's first sighting of a newborn humpback whale calf on our way to Molokini. Mom and calf swimming slowly with the calf just by the mom's rostrum.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 4 miles outside ma'alaea.  Mom and calf.  Calf was too small to be a yearling.  Little activity besides breathing and hanging out near the surface.  Encounter lasted 10 minutes before we needed to keep going to Molokini.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 3 adults at 3 miles off olowalu. one breached at 120 yards 3 times!! 30 minute encounter with 10 minute down times

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Same group as observed on previous whale watch trip.  One whale (presumably female) with white tail in center surrounded by thick black border on all sides.  Circling of whales around our boat, mugging!  and heavy blows/breathing.  Many fluke up dives.  Held hostage by whales!  Multiple circling and 2 males with beat up rostrum, 1 with big scratch on dorsal.  One breach as we are leaving!!!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: same comp pod of animals as before, minus one. 4 miles off olowalu, some of the same behavior as last ww, pec slapping, tail slapping. interspecies interaction with spinners

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: A group of three humpback whales that we believe are part of a competition group based on aggressive head lunges and tail blocks seen. Spinner dolphins (separate log) were also observed next to these whales.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: one sub-adult humpback, seen breaching from about 1.5mi away; upon approach whale pec slapped 2-3 times before diving; down times fairly short, 3-5 min; only 1 or 2 blows before diving; heading in general direction of Kaho'olawe, from Lahaina area

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: two HBWs, swimming along coastline of Launiupoko towards Lahaina; swimming slowly; diving after few blows

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Appeared to be mom/calf & escort. 3 miles off tunnel in 25 kts of wind. Tough to see but either mom or male did one peduncle throw

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Fluke up dives with 18 minute down times.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: od was watching pair before us, they were swimming about 5 knts toward channel with down times around 10 min.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: fluke up dives, long dive times.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: watched  them for three dives, down times 25, third time they came up at 150 yds and both breached once, and one breached twice. watched for two more dives

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: This mother calf pair was observed about two miles west of Wailea.  This pair was seen last week in nearly the same area, last week they were a little closer to shore. The calf is recognizable from two wounds on the left flank.  The wounds last week were very red, but his week they look as if they have healed to some extent.  The calf remains vigorous and looks to be a good size and is still remaining close to mom.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mugging!  Several whales in the area several hundreds of whales apart and away from each other.  Out of nowhere 2 whales seen underneath boat passing under us while we are stopped awaiting a re-surfacing!  A few breaths then fluke down dives!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: This pod of spinner dolphins located about one mile west of the Grande Wailea.  This may be the same pod that we saw earlier in the day at Makena Landing.  They were observed jumping in our wake and bow riding.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: This 25ft single individual was spotted originally from a distance, but again after a session of hydrophone.  This animal stayed on the surface next to the vessel for a few minutes and then did a fluke up dive at the back of the boat.  Originally, we thought this animal might be a calf.  However, given its large size, long down times, and no accompanying mother, we concluded that this animals is likely a yearly.  Also, this animal had many white marks along its dorsal surface that appeared to me a small healed scars.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: fluke up dives and fluke down dives.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 miles off wailea

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Amazing singing heard off Launiupoko.  Very windy and choppy today, gusting winds from the West Mauis.  Watched with Freedom and Explorer.  Only saw the whale once at the surface and then listened for 15-20 minutes

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 subadults..maybe another individual due to head lunge from subadult (female comp pod).  Few surfacing, fluke up and surface again.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: oq called us about two possiblly three whales, mid channel between lahaina and lanai, we watched two surface and dive together with 10 min down time, and a juv about 1/4 mi away, then saw juv and one other whale surface and dive together for next three dives, 11 and 15 min down times.  also, all three whales stayed with in 1/4 mi of navy sub the entire time we watched (sub just sitting, with people on top)

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Tail lob.  Appears to be a subadult whale.  Seen between Lanai and Maui headed east.  Surfaced for a few breaths and then fluke-up dove.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mother and calf with sub adult escort. Peduncle throws and tail slaps displayed by the animal presumed to be mother.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Peduncle throws by at least one whale. Possibly multiple.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: This whale breached twice after fluke up diving and staying down for about 5 minutes. Also displayed a few peduncle throws and pec slaps. We believe this whale to be a yearling or a very young whale based on its size and color of its tail.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: watched for 20 min., lots of direction changes, two surfaced together with only 5 min down time, activity picked up and then three traveling  together very fast , 8 knts, saw one pec slap twice. also so one whale within 1/4 mi possibly joining group

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Near Lanai.Not to active. Staying near surface then diving. Couple minute down time.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Two diving pairs within a mile of each other.  One pair with a 20 minute down time.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Two diving pairs within a mile of each other.  One pair with a 20 minute down time.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: This dolphin was traveling with Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins. The whale had extremely white pectoral fins that were visible most of the time. It did a few head rises with the dolphins near its face.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Diving for long periods of time.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: same comp pod as we watched on last ww, had traveled about 2 mi, were more surface active, surfacing every 3-5 min, traveling about 4 knts, 1 whale had about a grapefruit size chunk out of fin, one had white pecs, 1 raw tuberacles , and 1 with white scarred up lower lip

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Saw one breach and then didn't see it again.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: just outside the L buoy lahaina, it surfaced three times then dove, and we left

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: small sub adult swimming slowly just outside of 100 yards towards lanai. we are at 150 yards off the right side of the whale and freedom is about 200 yards off the left side of the whale. nice, lazy encounter with lots of surfacings. saw the tail flukes, little bit of white at the tips.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: juv, mid channel, watched for 45 min, think it was a female, whale was peduncle throwing and did 15-20 tail slaps, most were inverted

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: we were watching another whale, when this comp pod started within 1/2 mi. it started with four animals, when we left there were 5, we watched for 20 min, they would be down 10 -15 min

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: great encounter with comp pod of 6 (maybe more) animals! we are 5 miles off shore, between launiupoko and olowalu. some surface activity, head lunges and trumpeting. very cool bubble blasting that formed a perfect circle as it rose to the surface! one of the smaller animals had a deep v notch out of its left fluke. surfacing as a group every 3 minutes, headed towards kahoolawe, as we and freedom paralleled their course. they were traveling at about 5 knots and spent a lot of time at the surface.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: A group of three humpback whales that included one sub adult in the group. The group rested at the surface before diving, not showing too much surface activity. This group was observed 3 miles off the Olowalu area.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 4 animals in a mellow comp pod. occasionally an aggressive round out, and we had 2 head slaps in a row at one point in our encounter but this was the only real activity on the surface

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: comp pod! 7 original animals were seen and 2 left the group. some surface activity, but long down times. erratic behavior and direction changes without swimming in any clear direction. we are 1.5 miles from shore, off Launiupoko. we spent our entire ww with these animals, watching their activity levels increase.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: fluke up dive

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
location: just south and 1 mile out of harbor

breach from 1/4 mile from whales.  breaches and peduncle throws.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
location: just south and 1 mile out of harbor

breach from 1/4 mile from whales.  breaches and peduncle throws.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 whales, no surface behaviors, diving after a few blows.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Sub adult that breached just off our port side at around 100 yards! we approached the animal seen from 3 miles away and were waiting for it to approach when it broke the surface in a full breach! amazing encounter and we left as 3 other vessels approached. off in search of a reported pod of spinners in the area. we were 2 miles from Launiupoko and had a 30 minute encounter.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Sub adult that breached just off our port side at around 100 yards! we approached the animal seen from 3 miles away and were waiting for it to approach when it broke the surface in a full breach! amazing encounter and we left as 3 other vessels approached. off in search of a reported pod of spinners in the area. we were 2 miles from Launiupoko and had a 30 minute encounter.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Adult and calf or yearling.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: comp pod of 4 to 5 animals! OD called us over to this group and it was a great encounter! erratic directional changes, lots of time at the surface with inflated head lunges, trumpeting and a possible crucifix block! great encounter and we were able to spend 45 minutes with them

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: nice encounter with a single sub-adult. a single peduncle throw and then a fluke up dive. we waited 20 minutes for animal to resurface before heading in direction of another whale seen in the distance

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mugging! we approached what we thought was a single sub-adult and as we were waiting for it to resurface, one of the passengers exclaimed that it was underneath the boat! then 2 animals surfaced at 100 yards off our stern. we waited with our engines off as they both swam underneath our boat again and surfaced about 200 yards away! incredible!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: two whales, mid-channel to Lana'i; one small vessel also watching, maneuvering within 100 yards; one whale significantly smaller; potential mom and yearling; seem to be in restful state, swimming slowly and blowing few times before taking shorter dives

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
2 miles out of Molokini in front of Kahoolawe. 
Mom, calf, escort pod just quietly milling about.  Mom and escort surfaced irregularly and never sounded.  Calf was at the surface every minute or two.  Very young calf with an odd peach colored patch near its head.  I do not believe we were able to get a clear picture of the patch.  Encounter lasted 5 minutes before we had to continue to Lanai.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: surprise encounter with a sub-adult! we were headed towards a comp pod we sighted close to lanai when we saw a humpback surface 90 yards off our port bow. did a fluke up dive and we waited 15 minutes, but it did not resurface

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Competition pod....breaching from the distance, pec slaps, head rises and travel in a southbound direction at 3.5kts.  Fourth whale joined group.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We got to hang out with a mom and calf swimming slowly alongside us. We were able to shutdown our engines and here the mom's exhalations. The calf stayed right next to mom's dorsal fin. A great early encounter.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 3 HBWs in competition pod; longer down times than previously observed during last ww; down 5-7 min at a time; some head lunging but overall activity level is relatively mellow at surface for competition group; encounter lasted 45 min and activity level dropped significantly during encounter

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Whale was initially moving fairly quickly, then slowed dramatically and began resting at the surface. Whale is coming to surface every so often, but making no active movements or indications of adeeper dive.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mid channel between lahaina and lanai, watched for 50 min, had 25 min down times, it breached once about 100 yds off stern, then down another 20min before we left

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: about 5 mi off laniopoko, possibly two adults , we watched for 20 min, saw  mom at surface with calf on rostrum, only saw calf briefly and barely saw the blow

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: had been searching area for 30 min and had seen no blows, whale surfaced off port mid ship at 150 yds, breathed three times then dove

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: watched for 50 min it had 15 min down times, and during that time it circled within 1/4 mi, had two peduncle throws. also within 1/2 mi saw 3 adults

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: sub adult seen in the same area as 3 bottlenose. nice encounter half way across channel as we are returning to lahaina after our snorkel trip. long down times, not much surface activity from the whale, but bow riding from the bottlenose

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: A mom-calf-escort group located 4 miles outside of the harbor and 3.5 miles off the coast of S. Kihei. The calf in the group had red markings near the dorsal fin indicating some sort of trauma. Multiple boats have seen this same calf over the course of the week. The calf didn't seem to behave abnormally. In fact, we witnessed a breach and surface activity from the calf.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 3 full sized adults. Not to aggressive acting

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: FIRST CALF OF THE SEASON for Lahaina side!  Dorsal fin still folded over.  Calf is floppy and splashy, rolled over around mom and showed its tail edge.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 15 minute bottom time

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Unusual behavior, larger individual logging upon first approach.  atypical swimming/diving pattern, had large scratch marks on left flank behind eye

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 5 whale comp pod, many joiners and leavers at flanks of group as well, (2-3)

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 humpbacks  breaths and dive

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Fluke-up and Fluke-down dives.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: competition pod of 9 animals, moving very quickly to NW; lots of head lunges viewed; down time up to 5 min; mugged once for less than a minute; encounter lasted 40 min

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: saw cars on freeway pulled over so tucked in close to shore and saw three whales.  slow moving, then went offshore and other whale joined for more aggressive comp pod.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: incredible breaching from afar brought us in. continued breaches greeted us as we neared the whale. another is in the area but just breathing.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: inverted tail slapping by whale with all white tail!  peduncle throws.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: sub-adult, fairly active; peduncle throws; about 2 mi off Launiopoko

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: One lone whale also in the area; not interacting with this pair.  9 minute down times.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: competition pod with breaching and other big splashing with a pod of spinner dolphins thrown in the mix. we saw a whale breach immediately followed by a big spin from a spinner dolphin almost in response. Pectoral fin slaps and all!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mugging by sub adult! we were stopped watching the whale as 2 dolphins jumped and seemed to interact with the whale. as we waited for the whale to surface, we saw the whale at 100 yards off our mid ship. it then surfaced right off our starboard side, then dove across our bow, resurfacing at 50 yards off our port side.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Diving pair, two to three breathes and then they dive.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: awesome encounter with a subadult that is being very surface active! peduncle throwing, tail slapping, spending a lot of time at the surface. this is the most activity we've seen all day! there is another whale in the area, but we have seen very few surfacings. we are 2 miles from launiupoko, with a 30 minute encounter with a very active sub adult

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: traveling , 15 min down time, followed for 40 min

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Bottlenose dolphins hanging around a humpback sub adult

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: saw a quick blow from a subadult, with some spinners nearby

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp group with breaching, head lunges, peduncle throws. Spinners were present.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: surfacing and diving, mid channel about 3 m i from club

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Possible diving pair, one adult and one smaller adult, or one adult and one juvenile.  10-15 minute down time; surfaced off our stern and came towards our starboard.  One had white pectoral fins.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Possible diving pair, one adult and one smaller adult, or one adult and one juvenile.  10-15 minute down time; surfaced off our stern and came towards our starboard.  One had white pectoral fins.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We had just pulled up the hydrophone and were sitting dead in the water when the whale surface 10 ft. off the bow. We were also playing a recording of whale song since we didnt observe any song.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: watched these,  two, one did two peduncle throws, then they were traaveling 4 knts and crossed within 30 ft, sub adult crossed at bow just under surface at 10 ft, slowly turned and looked at boat as it crossed bow, then did a breach and then left

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: we saw this sub adult perform approximately 9 tail slaps then do a fluke up dive

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod!  At least 3 individuals traveling northeast, head lifts, inflated head lunge, followed by fluke up dives.  Encounter began at 14:40.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Yearling or subadult.  Repetitive behavior of: fluke-up dive followed by a partial breach followed by sharking and pec fin slapping 3-4 times.  This pattern was repeated 4+ times.  Whale traveling to the northwest; seen about three miles from Lahaina harbor south between Lanai and Kahoolawe.  Black tail, no obvious notches or scars.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Very active. Staying in same place. Breaching, head lunging, peck slapping, Belly up.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Short down times often. Active behavior. Peck slapping and surface splashing.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: One lazy half breach then logging at surface then a long down time

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: comp pod

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Very active at the surface, peduncle throws and tail slaps, rolling on side and raising flipper out of water, inverted tail slaps.  As this individual was active at the surface there seemed to be a reaction with another individual also tail slapping and flipper slapping.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Encounter began at 17:39 and ended at 17:45.  Active juvenile, seeming to react possibly communicate with subadult in previous OF encounter.  Reaction tail slaps, and flipper slaps.  Then complete change of behaviour, to MR with a few breaths at surface followed by fluke up dives.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: saw splashes from a distance, 3 whales surfaced together and down 15 min, watched for 25 min, they changed direction and swam toward boat, one surfaced off otherside, at about 20 yds

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Peduncle throwing and pec slapping subadult 5 miles out of Maalaea Harbor towards Molokini

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Very active breaching tail slapping pec slapping observation lasted about 30 minutes

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: MR at first, 3-4 breaths at surface, followed by fluke up dives.  Then suddenly 5 head slaps and a breach!  Awesome!  Then back to surface breaths and fluke up dives.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: watched for 20 min mid channel between lanai and kaanapali before it continued north into wind, 3-5 min down times, 5 headslaps

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: watched 30 min mid channel between lahaina and lanai, 5 min down time, did several peduncle throws

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Half a mile off the club. 4-5 Bottlenose dolphins interacting with 2 whales!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mugging by a juvenile off our stern and off our starboard side within 50 feet of boat.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Fluke up dove.  Seen off Club Lanai 3 miles offshore.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: pec slapping as we approached.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 pretty large blows but not sure how large the whales are.  East of Molokini between Molo and Pu'uoli.  Saw a few blows then a round out dive from both so we decided to continue on our route.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Diving pair, staying down for ~15 minutes at a time.  Surfaced off our stern and continued swimming towards us, diving at about 40 yards away. After we approached to about 250 yds, animals quickly switched directions 180 degrees and returned towards SW. After another 5 minutes the animals turned again and headed towards Lahaina. Surface activity was mild with a few head lunges behind the lead animal. Most individuals were mostly milling with a few fluke up dives and round outs. One individual looked to be smaller than the rest but the size was not confirmed. A hui hou.

properties.general_notes: On our way to Molokini, about halfway out, we saw a mother and a calf as well as an adult escort. We stayed for approximately ten minutes. The calf head slapped (potentially tried to breach) at least eight times within 20 yards from the boat. The escort dove under the boat and blew bubbles under the water underneath the boat, then he came back up to the surface less than 20 yards from our boat on the starboard side, and did a fluke-up dive about 50 yards away from the boat. The mom and the calf stayed at the surface.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We spotted a comp pod on our way to Molokini, and we went closer. Observed behaviors were several pectoral fin slaps, inflated head rises, blowing bubbles under water, and tail-down dives. One whale pec slapping repeatedly while swimming on  its back. The whales came as close as 46 yards (measured using the boat's laser range finder) away from the boat and therefore we had to watched the whales for approimately 15 minutes before the whales had traveled more than 100yrds away from the boat and we could continue to Molokini.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: One large individual noticed about 1000 yds away from a peduncle throw. As we approached about 250 yds animal began to swim towards OV. at about 150 yds animal turned around and swam away from OV. as we were leaving the whale did a few more peduncle throws followed by about 15 tail slaps. As the surface activity increased, other whales began to become more active. A few other whales about 2 miles away began also tail slapping. As we left another group was going towards the single individual we initially stopped for.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: research vessel watching. calf rolling in front of mom and on rostrum, just staying at surface. after 10 min, another escort joined, some splashing and picked up speed to 5 knts, they headed into wind line so we left for another comp pod about a 1 1/2 away

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663

mom calf escort. calf breaching continuously. while watching them 4 other sail boats came over to watch, so we sadly to leave to go watch other whales.  

came back an hour later and found same trio . calf continuing to breach and no other boats.  all turned and headed to cut across bow.

Maybe courting??

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: while watching a mother calf resting at the surface, we heard whale song through the hull! we dropped the hydrophone and heard the loudest whale song ever! singing stopped and the escort surfaced at 200 yards. dove and singing resumed. we could hear it inside the head it was so loud!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 2 adult HBWs; one leading the pair in overall southerly direction; second HBW acting very peculiar--snaking for prolonged periods while 1st whale dived; second whale trumpeting and flinging tail as well; behavior lasted for at least 30 min before we left the pair

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mugging! one whale just off starboard bow, rolled onto its back, pecs extended, thrusting its chin into the air. did this several times and on a few occasions we could see its eye. the other whale surfaced just beyond the curious whale and trumpeted, the curious whale followed the second whale to surface. both fluke up dived, and then the second whale (very white flukes) did a spy hop half breach at 50 yards, extending half of its body out of the water before landing on its back. started as a spy hop, ended as a breach

properties.general_notes: tail slaps

Much head-rising and a very fast moving group with what looked to be a sub adult out in the front of the pack frequently surfacing.  I do not believe we ever saw the female in the 10 minutes we spent watching them.

properties.general_notes: Comp pod.  2 miles in front of Harbor.  One animal breached twice as we approached and another did a peduncle throw.  2 fluked up within a few moments of us getting to 250 yards and the other three did not do a deep dive but disappeared for a few minutes before resurfacing close to where they were last seen.  All animals dove for another few minutes.  They then resurfaced 100 yards from the back of the boat with splashing and typical comp behavior.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Another comp pod, or perhaps the earlier one back in action.  There was a half hour lul in activity and there are many whales in the area.  Typical comp behaviors with head rises and jaw claps.  A large yearling or sub adult was seen at first but not again.  At one point we had 3 whales 150 yards away at our 11:00 position when suddenly another whale appeared at out 4:00 position about 90 yards away.  We sat dead in the water for at least 10 minutes as the brawling carried on around us.

properties.general_notes: 2 miles out of Olowalu.  SUper aggressive comp pod.  One animal came out of the water head first and within a hearbeat another launched itself out and onto its head in a rostrum/rostrum collision.  The aggressor whale then pushed the other whale down under the water! We were in a hurry so we only stayed for a few moments to watch them.  A third adult whale surfaced next to them but did not seem to be participating.

properties.general_notes:
Several miles off Lanai.  Initially seen at 1:00 position 250 yards away.  It was right at the edge of a distinct current line.  Tiny calf with visible angle to dorsal fin.  First saw the calf fluke slapping and thought it might be a dolphin it was so small!  Mom showed up a moment later and then sunk back down.  We only stayed a few minutes before we had to keep going to get to our second snorkel spot.
Actual time of sighting was 11:50 but we could not edit the minutes when entering the sighting after the fact.  We had no internet signal at the time.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663

Both the adults and the calf were very surface active, displaying multiple pectoral fin slaps and three lazy breaches. During our observation, the down time began to increase and the activity level also decreased indicating a change in behavior.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: An incredibly boat friendly competition group that mugged our vessel for 45 minutes. The group continuously circled the boat and displayed head lunges. Bubble streams were also seen throughout this observation and very evident from the deck of the boat. Amazing experience.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We saw a school of Spotteds who were milling around at least one HBW. We saw at least one aggressive head lunge towards the dolphins, who were swimming quickly and occasionally leaping. After 5 minutes the dolphins left, and we were quickly mugged by a large adult whale. The whale repeatedly circled under our boat, diving from side to side, and surfaced multiple times within 10 yards of us. Ten minutes into the mugging, a smaller (possibly subadult) whale approached the vessel. The smaller whale turned on her side multiple times, and we were able to see her hemispherical lobe. The larger whale left and the female continued to swim under and around us. We were mugged from 1:55 to 2:35.

properties.general_notes: Medium swimming,

The calf remained active during the time we watched this group. Observed 2 miles outside of the harbor as we began our snorkeling trip towards Molokini. Amazing way to start our trip!

After 15 min, we saw a third whale (escort) breach and land on its stomach between pair and vessel.  Waited another 10 min and trio turned to zig zap towards and very close to vessel on way to deeper water.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: found a comp pod with varying activity levels.  Started out more mellow swimming then escalated to ramming, head lunge, jaw clapping, and tail throwing.  At one point we were just sitting in neutral as whales just went outside 100 yards, and could hear singing through hull of vessel.  Comp singing or other whale?

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We saw the dolphins when we left our snorkeling spot outside of Lahaina. The dolphins came up to our boat, bow riding, and a few individuals were spinning out of the water. About five minutes after we spotted the dolphins we also saw a humpback whale calf on the surface doing a fluke-up dive. A zodiak type boat (not Ocean Freedom) drove right over the place where the calf dove down. The calf came back up to the surface shortly after the boat passed by. The mother humpback whale showed up about ten minutes after the baby showed up, and the two swm together for a few moments before diving back down, and that is when we left.

properties.general_notes:
We have no depth gauge in the boat at the moment or GPS.  I used my camera for coordinates and cannot fill in the depth.  

Comp pod with 5 core adult animals and a calf.  Motorboating, head rises, and bubble blowing observed.  Calf rolled around a bit and flapped its pec fins.  One other adult swam really quickly at the grouping from behind but once it was about 100 yards away from them, it turned around and swam away.  The mom and calf were in the center of the group for quite a while.  With another large adult leading the group... interesting.  We dropped the hydrophone about 400 yards away and heard pretty loud singing.

Hydrophone was in the water when the sighting started and we just pulled it up until it was barely in the water and kept listening!  It was an amazing mugging.  I have video.  One whale with a very white belly kept rolling over at the surface... we think it was a male.  Once one whale blew a ton of bubbles under the other and then the recepient started swishing its tail forcefully at the surface

Mom and calf ahead of males "nuzzling" calf rolling around on her head/back slapping its pectoral fins and tail off and on.  One male originally started to move off but then came  back toward the pod before again turning and leaving.  The mom started to pec slap repeatedly.  She kept it up for about 5 minutes straight.
