properties.general_notes: BREACH!!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf and escort traveling North slowly. Several fluke up dives by escort.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod of 4 adults.  Moving in a very clear direction.  Not overly active, just loudly exhaling and lunging at the surface.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Calf, cow, escort pod.  Mom and escort dove when we first saw them but calf remained near surface.  We stayed for a resurfacing of the adults about 6 minutes later and then departed for the harbor after they dove again.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Originally sighted by calf tail slapping repeatedly.  Mom down for long dive times and calf also holding their breath for over 15 minutes. After being down about 15 minutes they popped up several hundred yards off the other side of the boat.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Small calf with mom next to it.  She turned on her side and pec slapped.  THe other three adults were engaging in competitive behaviors like head rises, bubble blowing, and swishing their tails.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Lone subadult, breaching and peduncle throwing

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Tail slaps, peduncle throws, and underwater bubble blowing.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom and calf resting at the surface with 3 escorts head lunging, bubble blowing, and breaching.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mother, calf & 2 escorts.  Very playful calf exhibiting tail throws, breaching, side-swimming.  Male escort jaw clap & lots of direction changes.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf, and at least two escorts, possibly three. They were active and swam fast in a clear direction. We saw head rises, fluke up dives, bubble blowing, and a couple of peduncle throws.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mother, calf, escort.  Very small calf with white pec fins, dorsal fin slightly folded to the right.  Dives by male escort. Calf playing over and around mom.  Mugging!!  Mother & calf swimming right under us and traveling slowly.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mother, calf, escort.  Very small calf with white pec fins, dorsal fin slightly folded to the right.  Dives by male escort. Calf playing over and around mom.  Mugging!!  Mother & calf swimming right under us and traveling slowly.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mugged! Competition pod of 4 whales moving around Ocean Discovery. Lots of changes of direction, one did a head stand right next to the boat. The female maybe hiding under the boat, and the males are circling the vessel.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: big breach by boat

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: comp. pod

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: calf cow escort

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Competition group passing close by our stern. Head lunges from multiple whales.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: calf breaching and playful; circling above mom; long down times for mom (more than 15 min), mugged by calf about 30 yards off bow; mom did not seem to care or concerned about calf's proximity to boat

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Competitive behavior ensued including head lunges and bubble blowing

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: competitive pushing and jostling exhibited.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 9 animal comp group with 2 joiners; traveling south; bubble blasting and head lunging

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Looked like possibly female, yearling, escort. Pec slapping from one. The small one was just swimming with them. The other was head lunging, peduncle throwing, jaw clapping. One breach from one of the adults.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Calf logging behavior.  1 full breach by calf

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp group. At one point they dove about 150 yards off the starboard bow and then resurfaced 50 yards off of our port stern. Lots of pec slapping, head lunging.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: One of these  individuals has whale lice.  Observed pink patches on dorsal right side of body from the dorsal fin to the start of the rostrum.  Confirmed to be lice from viewing with binoculars and we got very good photos from guests on board.  These whales were moving in one direction (SE) and not surface active so we did not see any more of the whale than what was noted above.  Did not see any signs of entanglement on the portion of whale we were able to see.  Called the Entanglement Hotline and reported sighting

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: This competition pod started with what appeared to be on 3 to 4 whales. After about 15 minutes of observation it appeared that at least two other whales from opposite directions joined the group. At least two other pods were observed within a mile of this pod that we were watching.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mother and calf with competition pod.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: calf very surface active; breaching, pec slapping, tail thrashing.  Female and escort milling, not very surface active

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Breach! First sighting of pair from about 600 yards. They continued moving, and on next surfacing, we saw pec slapping.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: whale chin slapping and milling just off from reef's end at molokini

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: whale chin slapping and milling just off from reef's end at molokini

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom and calf initially seen tail slapping together upon approach 1/2 mile away.  As we got a bit closer the calf began breaching and head slapping.  It was very light in color and appeared to be very small.  Mom was not observed much after the calf started breaching.  Another adult came in toward the mom/calf pod but may not have been interacting with them.  It too disappeared toward the end of the 10 minute sighting.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 5 in competition pod with an additional 2 that left the group.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Small, pale Calf breaching repeatedly then mom did a full breach.  Escort trailing behind them pec slapping.  Escort and mom disappeared and calf continued breaching at least another dozen times.  We left them after 30 minutes of observation.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf, escort.  Large splash from an adult observed from a distance.  Two large blows also observed.  Calf repeatedly breaching As we drew closer and the escort disappeared.  The mom and calf began logging with the calf perpendicularly laying across her rostrum.  We needed to get in to run the 3pm ww, so we left after 5 minutes.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: pec slapping and breaching

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mother and calf just moving slowly and milling, but three males head lunging and tail throwing and swimming under the boats.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 4 animal comp pod.  much diving upon each other and aggressive displaying like head rising and blowing bubbles.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: spinner dolphins traveling with whales

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf, male escort, and bottlenose dolphin swimming in one group

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mom, calf, escort

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Surprise encounter, 20 yards

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom and calf with active breaching baby.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod of five whales joined by two more. Bubble trails, peduncle throws, jaw claps and inflated head lunges as the circled around the Voyager. As we were leaving they were heading in the direction of another comp pod at least 10 whales strong.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We saw two groups of whales; one mom and calf pair, and one group of at least three adults. One of the three adults was moving fast through the water, diving fast, and swimming on the side in close proximity to the other adults. We also observed a school of at least five adult bottle nose dolphins less than a hundred yards away from the whales. The dolphins spent a few minutes right at the spot where the mom and calf just dove down, but it is a little unclear wether it was a true interspecies interaction since they were not observed in the same place at the same time.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We saw two groups of whales; one mom and calf pair, and one group of at least three adults. One of the three adults was moving fast through the water, diving fast, and swimming on the side in close proximity to the other adults. We also observed a school of at least five adult bottle nose dolphins less than a hundred yards away from the whales. The dolphins spent a few minutes right at the spot where the mom and calf just dove down, but it is a little unclear wether it was a true inter-species interaction since they were not observed in the same place at the same time.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: The group was swimming in medium speed in a clear direction. We observed inflated head rises, swift turns, swimming on the side, and whales seemingly pushing each other.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod.  Beginning of encounter animals were fast  swimming.  When surface active, aggressive behaviors observed (peduncle throw, head lunges, inflated head lunge).  After 30 minutes several other adults joined the pod (initial group 5 animals) for a total of at least 8.  Observed repeated inflated head lunges with joiners.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Calf has white dorsal fin.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Did not stay with this group for long... time to head back to the harbor

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Two losers swam away...head lunging, lots of underwater action, tail slap, peduncle throws..

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Fairly surface active comp pod.  Head lunge, pec slap, head slap observed.  Before we left the pod one adult did a spy hop.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes:
Note:  previous recorded observation on OI had incorrect GPS coordinates .  This sighting is the same, with (hopefully) correct coordinates.  Disregard previous sighting (cow/calf).  
Calf breached several times.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Triple fluke up dive!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom & calf mugging, swimming past our bow and circling vessel.  Male escort repositioning himself between us & mom&calf.  Then at 100 yards mom rolling over, pec slapping and a breach at 150 yards!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Right outside the harbor. Close approach.  Mugged for about 20 minutes!!  Calf had a large gouge on left flank (posterior and ventral from the dorsal fin).  The wound was red in the center and white at the edges.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mother logging

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mugged by a slow moving competition pod centering around a mother and calf. The males dove under the boat several times. Seeing some bubble blasts, inflated head thrusts, and lots of direction changes. One male has bloody tubercles.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: This large individual swam under the vessel and was observed spinning and swimming upside down. This animal actually rolled on the surface and clearly showed a hemispherical lobe...indicating that we had a female.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Hazy.  Fast moving comp pod with calf.  Some direction changes, deeper dives with one male breaking off and circling back in.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Very surface active comp pod!  We stayed with this pod for 45 minutes and observed tail slapping, head slapping, peduncle throws, numerous breaches (from a disassociating animal), pec slapping, sharking, and spy hopping.  We were mugged by 2 adults for about 15 minutes.  The pair swam under the boat 4 times.  Pec fins on one of the adults were almost all white (both ventral and dorsal sides).  amazing whale watch.  WOW!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Breaching calf

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Breach bubble blowing

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Two adults milling active within 400 yards

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Yearling, seemingly without an accompanying adult.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: yearling; playful, pec slapping, peduncle throws; no mother or other whales nearby, mugged boat once; fluke prints not set in yet--still young whale but not a calf; shows signs of having been in alaska with barnacle marks around chin

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom calf and escort.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Calf breaching.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: cow and calf resting at surface

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Typical comp pod with head rises, bubble blowing, and one animal pec slapping.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Very active comp pod with head rising and much inflated head lunges.  One animal frequently pec slapping.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: 3 Bottlenose dolphins swimming with mom, calf and escort

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: There were 2 bottlenose dolphins swimming with this comp. pod. The surface activity wasn't extremely active, but we saw a couple inflated head lunges and also one very fast spy hop or vertical head lunge

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Active calf.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Near miss; whale surfaced just 5 feet off the port side.  No physical contact between the boat and the whale was felt or heard.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Lazy group.  Mom and calf were first observed at surface with calf, but quickly dove after a few breaths leaving the calf to hang near the surface for about 10 minutes before surfacing again.  They then took a few quick breaths and again fluke-up dove leaving the calf at the surface.  We only watched for about 20 minutes.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We got our faces mugged off!  This adult pair kept sworling all around and under the boat surfacing very close and frequently rolling into each other before suddenly swimming away from us after about 15 minutes of mugging!  We had our engines turned off, just sitting there.  I observed the depth finder drop 100 feet in an instant as one swam beneath us.  They were releasing small streams of bubbles under the boat from time to time.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Head lunge

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: mom, calf, and at least 2 males in low level competition; circling around boat, mom and calf leading the pod; mugged within yards

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Small comp pod. Double Breach!!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We observed the whale tailslapping and doing a lazy breach. The whale swam right underneath the boat.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Surprise!!!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Head slaps, breaches, pec slaps, tail slaps, peduncle throws.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Breaching! Then after diving surfaced about 80 yards off of our starboard bow, then swam off towards our stern.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf, escort pod moving quickly one direction and then suddenly shifting to come within 50 yards of the boat.  Calf popped up closest and then quickly changed direction again heading back away to join adults.  There may have been a dolphin present.  One crew and a few passengers saw one for an instant, but it was not resighted.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Major breachage....j

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: milling

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: breaching baby

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: We observed a lazy breach and a few blows.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: One whale breaching twice and then doing a peduncle throw. The two other whales were calmer but we did observe a few fast dives on the side (so that half the fluke was visible above the surface), and what looked like one whale pushing another whale.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Calf milling near surface, swimming towards the boat. Mother underwater for long periods, resting.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod, that broke up to diving pair.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom and calf popped up right along side of the starboard side, very close to the boat. We watched them up at the surface for a few blows and moved on once they were out of the 100yrds.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf, escort.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom & Calf & Escort.  Mugging next to boat!! Calf draped across mother's rostrum.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Possibly a mother and yearling with two escorts.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp group with peduncle throws and breaches.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: calf cow escort

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: comp pod

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf, escort that cruised straight for us and then disappeared reemerging well away from us in the opposite direction.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Looks like a comp pod of 3 animals with fast chase-like swimming and frequent shallow diving.  All three arched and dove, 2 roundouts and 1 fluke up. They came up again a few minutes later on the other side of the boat.  and continued to chase each other. Many other groups in immediate area too.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod that came very close several times.  They were definitely chasing one whale.  There was a lot of head rising and bubble blowing.  A bubble screen was even observed!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: group moving erratically, zigzaging mid-chanel; mom and calf leading pack; mom releasing bubble trails as well as males; jaw clap right in front of boat at 60 yards; joiners seen around area/in vicinity

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod swimming around moorings south of harbor.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf, 2 escort group with minor aggressive displaying between the escorts.  Tail slapping mostly, and swimming fast after the mom and calf.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Comp pod of 5 adults initially with Frogman.  Frequent direction changes with one animal in the lead.  That whale, presumably the female would stretch out at the surface and pec slap a few times every few minutes.  There was on large animal right next to her with barely a dorsal fin left.  It kept doing head rises right after she would surface.  THey approached with in 61 yards of the boat during a mugging.  There was much trumpeting and head rising and a lot of fluke up dives though they were only a few minutes in duration.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf, escort x3.  This appears to be a comp pod that we saw a ways off but has slowely been travelling our direction.  The last logged comp pod is still near us about 400 yards away.  The calf in the pod has come very close to the boat.  From a distance, we observed much bubbles, splashing, and pec slapping from one animal.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Breaching mom and calf

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: two subadults, peduncle throw from one humpback whale, pectoral slap from another, unique coloration on the pectoral fin of the individual pec slapping, similar to the HBW observed on the previous whale watch.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Lone adult breaching repeatedly.  More than a dozen times in 10 minutes!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Calf hanging near the surface taking a few breaths every few minutes.  Mom and escort surfaced for two short breathing sessions but otherwise remained absent.  Male had what lookedlike entanglement scars forward of its dorsal fin running down its body.  Right when we were about to give up on them they turned and came back again.  The  escort was SAILING!!  Several times!  Mom and calf, and escort mugged us and swam back and fourth under the boat.  The escort blew next to the boat and showered us twice!

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: watching 2 whales then they joined a comp pod of 5

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: There were five whales total. A loser left the group and swam under the boat.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom and calf with an active mom doing multiple chin slaps.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Mom, calf and escort, slowly swimming by.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: One group wih a mom and calf, and one single adult about 500yards away from the mom and calf.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663
properties.general_notes: Surprise encounter with a subadult sticking his fluke up out of the water. He then did several spy hops and chin slaps.

properties.creator: 9879626d-84f0-441d-adfa-0ce677417663

All of a sudden, one whale breached completely out of the water less than 50 yards in front of the boat's bow. Then it breached again and continued to do five consecutive lazy breaches while heading in a direction away from the competition pod.

Very white belly, pec fins, and all white fluke on this primary escort.  Multiple tail slaps, tail throws and breaches.  Challenger leaves group a few breaching followed by inverted tail slaps.  More breaching by white bellied male.

properties.general_notes: Breaching baby!

Mother and calf interacting, calf rolling over and interacting with mother.  mother and calf mugged the boat, followed by a breach from one of the adults, not sure if it was the male or female.  mugged for five minutes then left 100 yard limit.

Female at one time spy hopped, ventral side towards the stern of the boat, just 12 yds away!  Female hovered just under the surface for most the time, seemingly observing us.  Not much comp pod behavior observed.  amazing!

It was not bloody and no blubber was exposed.  The scar was very obvious, trailing down the middle/right side of back and the coloration was normal (dark grey).

properties.general_notes: Two seperate groups were observed in the is area.  On one side of the vessel, there was a cow and calf and within a half a mile off of the other side of the vessel, there was a cow, calf and escort. The cow calf pair were swimming in the direction of the other pod.

properties.general_notes: This group was behaving very irregularly. One whale was half-spyhopping and sutrfacing a bit off-kilter when it needed to breath. We examined this sighting closely as we suspected the whale could possibly be entangled. The whale "snaked" it's tailstock from one side to the other. We didn't see any line around the peduncle, but the group didn't stray from the spot they were in and didn't dive. No whale lice was observed. Possible hypothesis: labor? 2 other whales milled about at surface, half-spyhopping from time to time. None of us have seen this weird behavior before.
